'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Erich Hawbaker DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Erich Hawbaker]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Raw Deal
* '''Username:''' der junker
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
